allowed.comment: protocol/: the spec's module, the rules derived from it, the prose, the tools' schemas and the readers of the tools' inputs; imports the support folders
harness/: the neutral turns, the adapter that builds them and the harness's entities; imports protocol/
artefacts/: what lives outside the session and how its status is read; imports protocol/
items/: the draft's answers, the items raised and Done, what an item frees, the count line and what kanban_outstanding gives; imports protocol/, harness/ and artefacts/
views/: what the pane and a reply draw; imports every layer
text/, json/: support; import each other and config/, and no layer
config/: support, the settings, read by the bundled YAML parser in vendor/; imports text/ and json/, and no layer
hooks/, cli/, tools/: the edges; import anything

forbidden.name: no-cycle
forbidden.comment: No module reaches itself through its imports

forbidden.name: no-engine-in-core
forbidden.comment: The core imports no engine: claude-code is the hooks' alone

forbidden.name: no-node-built-in-in-core
forbidden.comment: The core imports no Node built-in: no file, process, timer or clock

forbidden.name: no-edge-in-core
forbidden.comment: The core imports nothing from the hooks, the CLI or the build steps
